canrpgbear.Name: Bear (Druid Bear Form)
canrpgbear._comment_AnimationsMetaData: Remaps the player's seraph locomotion codes onto the bear shape's OWN animations. The shape carries two roots - invisible seraph pivots (root/LowerTorso/UpperTorso + UpperArm/UpperFoot, required or the vanilla player renderer crashes) and 'Cube1' (the bear mesh, with its own neck/head the head-controller tracks). Seraph animations only move the invisible seraph branch, so without this remap the bear body would slide. CRITICAL: the target 'animation' MUST equal the seraph code, so the vanilla bear 'Run' clip was renamed to 'sprint' in the shape to match (see the wolf recipe).
